shortcuts.favourite: Add to or remove from favourites
shortcuts.newTemplate: Start a new template or policy

finder.title: Documents
finder.intro: Documents attached to the records you can open. Each document follows its record: if you cannot open the record, you never see its documents.
finder.search: Search by title, reference, file or record
finder.noneBody: Upload a document to a lead, customer, unit or project you can work on.

preview.fictional: Fictional demo document: not a real record, approval or authority.
preview.pdfFallback: This browser cannot show the PDF here. Use “Download demo file” to open it.
preview.none: No preview for this kind of file. You can still download it.

workspace.intro: Preview, versions, related records and history of this document. It is visible only to people who can open its record.
workspace.expiryBody: The current version is valid until {{date}}. Upload the renewed copy as a new version; earlier versions are kept.

versions.finderIntro: Choose a document to see all its versions and compare them.
versions.title: Versions of {{title}}
versions.intro: Every upload adds a version; nothing is overwritten or deleted. Compare any two versions below.

expiring.title: Expiring documents
expiring.intro: Documents of the records you can open that have expired or expire soon, soonest first.
expiring.basis: Worked out from today’s business date, {{date}}, and each document’s current version.
expiring.noneBody: Documents of records you cannot open are not listed or counted here.

upload.title: Upload a document
upload.subtitle: Attach a demo file to a record you can work on
upload.demoNote: Demo only: the file stays in this browser’s demo session. Nothing is uploaded to a server or shared.
upload.recordPlaceholder: Type a name, reference or unit
upload.recordHint: Only leads, customers, units and projects you can work on are listed.
upload.recordNone: No record you can work on matches
upload.fileHint: PDF, PNG, JPG, WebP, text or CSV, up to {{max}}.
upload.expiryHint: Identity documents always need one. Expiry warnings use this date.
upload.noteHint: Up to 300 characters. Kept in the document’s history.
upload.done: Uploaded {{ref}} (demo file, kept in this browser)
upload.replayed: {{ref}} was already uploaded by this request: nothing new was created

errors.record: Choose the record this document belongs to.
errors.title: Enter a title of 3 to 120 characters.
errors.fileType: This kind of file is not accepted. Use PDF, PNG, JPG, WebP, text or CSV.
errors.fileRead: The file could not be read. Choose it again.
errors.expiry: Enter the expiry date of the identity document.
errors.note: Say in a few words what changed (at least 3 characters).
errors.refused: The upload was refused; nothing was saved.
errors.unavailable: That record is not available to you. Nothing was saved.

unavailable.title: Document not available
unavailable.body: It does not exist or is not available to you.

problems.recordRequired: Choose the record this document belongs to.
problems.recordKind: Documents can be attached to leads, customers, units and projects.
problems.title: Enter a title of 3 to 120 characters.
problems.fileName: The file name is not valid.
problems.fileType: This kind of file is not accepted.
problems.fileSize: The file must be smaller than {{max}}.
problems.fileUnreadable: The file could not be read. Choose it again.
problems.expiryRequired: Identity documents need an expiry date.
problems.versionNote: Say in a few words what changed (3 to 300 characters).
problems.storeFull: The demo’s file storage is full. Reset the demo to start again.
problems.idempotencyKeyReused: This request was already used for something else. Nothing was changed; try again.
problems.templateName: Enter a name of 3 to 120 characters.
problems.effectiveFrom: Choose a date from today onwards.
problems.versionPending: A draft of this template is waiting for approval. It is decided first.
problems.notPending: This version has already been decided.
problems.ownDraft: You drafted this version, so another person approves it.
problems.returnNote: Say why the draft is returned (3 to 300 characters).

templates.title: Templates and policies
templates.intro: Letters, checklists and policies. A new version is drafted, approved by another person and takes effect on its date. Nothing is edited in place.
templates.illustrative: All wording here is illustrative demo text, not legal advice.
templates.newSubtitle: Its first version waits for another person’s approval
templates.drawerNote: The draft takes effect only after someone else approves it. You can never approve your own draft.
templates.awaiting_one: {{count}} draft is waiting for your approval.
templates.awaiting_other: {{count}} drafts are waiting for your approval.
templates.noEffectiveBody: The first version takes effect once it is approved and its date arrives.
templates.noneBody: Templates of projects you cannot open are not listed.
templates.mineNote: You drafted this version: another person approves it.
templates.ownDraft: You drafted the version waiting for approval, so another person decides it.
templates.approveEffect: It takes effect on {{date}} and replaces the version in effect then. The history keeps every version.
templates.returnEffect: The drafter sees your reason and can draft a new version. Nothing takes effect.
templates.name: Name
templates.bodyHint: Placeholders such as buyer.name or unit.ref stay as typed in this prototype.
templates.effectiveHint: Today or later. It takes effect only once approved.
templates.noteHint: 3 to 300 characters, kept in the history.
templates.draftDone: Version {{n}} drafted and sent for approval

errors.name: Enter a name of 3 to 120 characters.
errors.effectiveFrom: Choose a date from today onwards.
errors.note: Say in a few words what changed.
